patch_description: This crossover retains the strong softmin/softmax Adam packing optimization from the current program while adding a deterministic legacy-seeded initialization inspired by the simple random prior program. It uses 13 reproducible starts, including the legacy `RandomState(42)` sample, and slightly reduces iterations per start to keep total runtime close to the original. A shared optimization routine removes duplicated code while retaining separate broad-search and sharp-polish phases. The returned array is always finite with shape `(14, 3)`.
